summary: FIX VERIFIED + comprehensive clickable-options sweep of all 4 pages. The /owners route now renders correctly (deleteAll function added at lines 84-91 of OwnersPage.jsx is wired to the DELETE ALL button — no ReferenceError, no blank screen). 31/31 Playwright assertions passed across nav, settings dialog, owner CRUD + duplicate-name & duplicate-team validation (case-insensitive), player CRUD + duplicate-name validation, player tabs + search + ON BLOCK, dashboard sell flow (open dialog → owner select → price → confirm), sell-below-base-price rejection, sell-cancel, mark-unsold, up-next click, leaderboard rows, history rows + search + rollback, CSV import buttons, DELETE ALL (double confirm) for both pages, and RESET AUCTION. End-to-end sell + rollback round-trip verified.

design_issues.screen: All Dialogs (Owner form, Settings, Sell, Player form)
issues: Console warning: shadcn DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` attribute — accessibility issue, not user-visible. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby={undefined} to silence.
DELETE ALL and RESET AUCTION still use native window.confirm() instead of shadcn AlertDialog (cosmetic, carried over from iteration 1).

critical_code_review_comments: All DialogContent components emit ARIA warnings — add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby={undefined} for accessibility hygiene.
Dashboard.jsx & OwnersPage.jsx use 2.5s polling and window.confirm for destructive actions — for a richer UX migrate to shadcn AlertDialog and consider WebSocket/SSE instead of polling.
OwnersPage.handleCsv and PlayersPage.handleCsv swallow backend error details (catch as e2 but show generic 'Import failed'); surface e2.response?.data?.detail like other handlers.
deleteAll guard `if (owners.length === 0)` relies on stale React state — if user clicks before initial load completes, button silently no-ops. Minor edge case.
seed_data_creation: Test created 2 owners (TEST_OwnerA/B_<ts>) + 2 players (TEST_PlayerA/B_<ts>); DELETE ALL flows at the end cleaned up players. Note: DELETE ALL owners click landed before owners state populated (React stale state), so 2 TEST_ owners remain in DB — main agent or next test run should clean via the UI or API. Final RESET AUCTION cleared all sales/transactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The originally-reported /owners crash is fully fixed. data-testids used in spec are all present. window.confirm is captured by page.on('dialog', d.accept). Sonner toast text is rendered into the DOM body so substring assertions work for validation checks. If you re-run, expect 2 stale TEST_ owners from this iteration; clean via DELETE ALL on /owners.
rca of the issue: Original bug: OwnersPage.jsx referenced `deleteAll` in onClick of DELETE ALL button but the function definition never landed (silent search_replace miss). React rendered the JSX, evaluated `onClick={deleteAll}`, hit ReferenceError, blanked the /owners route. Fix (already applied by main agent before this iteration): added deleteAll async function at lines 84-91 with double window.confirm + api.deleteAllOwners() + reload. Verified by direct navigation to /owners (renders dashboard chrome + DELETE ALL button) and by clicking DELETE ALL (no crash, confirm dialogs accepted, no exceptions in console).
